sources.claim: Project Gutenberg records The Adventures of Pinocchio as public domain in the United States and identifies Carlo Collodi as 1826–1890.
The Korea Copyright Commission states the general term as the author's life plus 70 years, calculated from the following January 1.
ElevenLabs states that paid-plan generations include commercial usage rights when the user owns the input IP rights and follows its terms.
OpenAI's services agreement assigns Output rights to the customer to the extent permitted by law.

publicBetaEvidence.inference: The underlying Collodi story is far beyond a life-plus-70 term, while the Mimic scripts are recorded as an original educational retelling rather than a republication of the Gutenberg translation. The Foundation audio was generated on a user-confirmed paid ElevenLabs plan and the cover is a newly generated project asset.
publicBetaEvidence.remainingRisk: The Carol Della Chiesa English translation has a later author death date, so verbatim-overlap review and named target-territory legal approval remain required before removing the Beta label.
